title.zh: 查询下载认证数据任务详情信息
title.en: Query download task details for authentication data

descriptions.zh:
根据查询条件获取产品方案下的统计调用数据文件的下载链接。
- 方法：HTTPS POST
- 服务地址：cloudauth.aliyuncs.com

> 实人认证产品以CertifyId统计调用量，为了方便对账请在您的系统留存CertifyId字段。
descriptions.en:
Retrieves the download link of a statistical call data file under a product plan based on query conditions.
- Method: HTTPS POST
- Endpoint: cloudauth.aliyuncs.com

> ID Verification uses CertifyId to calculate the call volume. To facilitate reconciliation, retain the CertifyId field in your system.
